verdicts.reason: Both break the headline into meaningless fragments with spaces (A: 'CONS TRUC / TION', B: 'CONS / TRUC TION'). In both, the brick hero is shrunk to a thumbnail with its blue X cut off sharply on the right. The $14.99 price, a focal point in the original, drops to fine-print size below 'Buy 2 only for'. The right column is crowded while the left half has dead space under the headline. B is marginally better: its product image is slightly larger and its CTA box sits more tightly with the offer copy, but it shares all of A's major flaws.
